intro: Lesson 10: Zakah: purifying wealth. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: What is zakah?
points: A pillar of Islam, often paired with salah (2:43)
Wealth belongs to Allah; we are trustees
A right of the poor, not a favour

model.title: Yahya has held £5,200 in savings, above the nisab, for one lunar year. How much zakah does he pay?

panels.title: Zakah recipients (9:60)
points: Those whose hearts are being brought together

blocks.text: Each amount is savings held for one lunar year, above the nisab. Zakah is 2.5%: find 10%, then a quarter of it.

keywords.def: the minimum wealth before zakah is due
one full lunar year of holding the wealth
a small charity paid before the Eid prayer at the end of Ramadan

questions.q: Calculate the zakah on £3,600 of savings held above the nisab for a lunar year.
Zakah or sadaqah: giving £5 to a charity box on any day you choose.

questions.a: One lunar year of holding the wealth

questions.q: Zakah problems (pupil PDF): a) £8,000 b) £12,400 c) £1,600 savings held a lunar year, all above the nisab. Then write two sentences in the portal response box on how zakah helps society.
questions.a: a) £200 b) £310 c) £40. Helps the poor and debtors, reduces inequality, builds unity.

questions.q: Extend: explain the difference between zakah, sadaqah and zakat al-fitr.
questions.a: Zakah: obligatory 2.5% yearly above the nisab. Sadaqah: voluntary, any time. Zakat al-fitr: small fixed charity before the Eid prayer.

questions.q: Stretch: how does zakah show that wealth is a trust from Allah?
questions.a: The owner must give the share Allah set to those He named; wealth is held for Allah, not owned absolutely.

questions.q: Which of these can receive zakah according to 9:60?
questions.a: A) A person struggling with debt. Debtors are one of the eight groups. Zakah is for those named in 9:60, not the rich.

questions.q: Which surah lists the eight groups of zakah?
Think again: what would change in your town?
questions.a: Less poverty and debt, more care and unity.
